tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.tachi.data:
Blade length 1.0 m, forged from general-purpose high-speed steel.
A mass-produced blade assigned to constructs; a common model that is also the easiest to use.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.tachi.story: The standard-issue tachi for constructs, used by those who specialize in tachi attacks.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.hugotou.dat:
Blade length 0.8 m, forged from general-purpose high-speed steel. Sturdier than the standard tachi,
and its slightly shorter design makes it easier to carry as a self-defense weapon.
A short blade slightly longer than an arm, generally used for self-defense.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.hugotou.sto: A factory-line weapon, adequate as a self-defense arm. - Weapon Designer Z
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.mumei.data:
Blade length 0.9 m, forged from experimental high-speed steel with solid overall quality.
A blade with no craftsman's name engraved, yet no less cold and sharp as a weapon.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.mumei.story: Like its name, Mumei - unremarkable. - Weapon Designer Z
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.kyuuji.skil: Attacks have a 20% chance to call down lightning, dealing 50% physical DMG. 3-second cooldown.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.kyuuji.data:
Blade length 0.9 m, forged from ultra-hard high-speed steel and fitted with a small firing device.
Slashes have a chance to trigger the device, producing an attack that resembles lightning.
A strange tachi modeled after an old-era famous blade.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.kyuuji.stor: Dealing ranged damage with a melee weapon - a wonderful idea. - Weapon Designer Z
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.honglian.sk: Basic attack extra DMG bonus +10%. Each basic attack increases physical DMG by 5% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Reapplication refreshes the duration.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.honglian.st:
By my calculations, Honglian's performance will not drop even against a volcanic eruption.
Do not stop me - I am going to throw it in to prove my algorithm. - Weapon Designer I
tooltip.icy_punishing.inverse_fragment_h: A fragment exclusive to Honglian. Hold Honglian in your main hand with this in your offhand and right-click to raise its ascension.
A residual inverse fragment peeled from Honglian's blade, still bearing traces of the resonance between construct and weapon.
tooltip.icy_punishing.inverse_fragment_d: A fragment exclusive to Shadowblade - Inverse Severance. Hold it in your main hand with this in your offhand and right-click to raise its ascension.
A residual inverse fragment peeled from the blade, still bearing traces of the resonance between Dawn and lightning.
tooltip.icy_punishing.ascension_chip_daw: A leap chip exclusive to Shadowblade - Inverse Severance. Hold it in your main hand with this in your offhand and right-click to raise its leap level (max 54).
A chip recording Lucia: Dawn's combat data; each leap further improves the blade's affinity for lightning.
tooltip.icy_punishing.inverse_fragment_h: A fragment exclusive to Hongying. Hold Hongying in your main hand with this in your offhand and right-click to raise its ascension.
An inverse fragment peeled from Hongying's blade, still echoing the sword-song of the Crimson Abyss.
tooltip.icy_punishing.ascension_chip_hon: A leap chip exclusive to Hongying. Hold Hongying in your main hand with this in your offhand and right-click to raise its leap level (max 54).
A chip recording Lucia: Crimson Abyss's combat data; each leap sharpens the edge of her sword aura.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.hongying.sk:
Each orb cleared increases physical DMG by 2% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Reapplication refreshes the duration.
Entering Sword Aura state grants 1 extra sword orb; 10-second cooldown.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.hongying.st:
Before the falling sakura could touch the ground, they were all split in two by the high-speed blade light.
The white-haired girl sheathed the crimson tachi, looking very satisfied with this forging.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.tianlang.sk:
When placed in the offhand, it floats behind and above the player, automatically attacking hostile mobs within 12 blocks,
prioritizing the player's most recently attacked target (regardless of faction), once per second.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.tianlang.da:
Blade length 1.1 m, equipped with a kinetic conversion device and a simple autonomous attack module.
The conversion device turns the kinetic energy of the weapon's motion into aggressive light blades.
Press the switch on the hilt to extend or retract the light blades.
Outside combat, Sirius appears as only a hilt, making it very easy to carry.
Its strength is comparable to other weapons, but its stunning appearance has made it widely sought after and collected.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.tianlang.st:
It breaks the limits of material and expresses its nature with pure energy.
This blade deserves to be recorded in history. - Weapon Designer Z
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.yingda.skil:
Each time lightning DMG is dealt, lightning DMG bonus +5% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times; reapplication refreshes the duration.
Casting the Signature grants an extra DMG bonus +10% for 10 seconds; reapplication refreshes the duration.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.yingda.data:
Blade length 1.1 m, forged from a high-entropy alloy with a trace of silver.
Compared with physical slashing, Inverse Severance is better suited to attacks imbued with elements;
its excellent conductivity greatly benefits constructs that rely on lightning attacks.
Designer ■■■■■ was ■■■■ due to ■■■■ and is now ■■■■■■■■.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.yingda.stor:
According to records, Inverse Severance was forged from the leftover material of True Severance.
Even as leftovers it possesses considerable power, and where True Severance is now, no one knows.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.zhuhua.skil: Ice DMG +15%. After a 3-orb clear, all DMG +10% for 5 seconds.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.zhuhua.data:
Blade length 0.9 m, forged with a composite process of extremely high precision.
As temperature changes, the blade's color gradually changes as well,
and in extreme cases faint dark-red ice patterns even appear.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.zhuhua.stor:
Where it cuts, no blood flows, for the wound is frozen the instant it is opened.
The effects of the low temperature mean even the victim cannot notice when they were cut down.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.sarariel.sk: Dark DMG +15%. Attacks have a 15% chance to release a shadow shockwave, dealing 75% dark DMG. 0.5-second cooldown.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.sarariel.da:
Blade length 0.9 m; the blade can unfold from a single edge into a double edge, leaving double wounds on enemies.
It does not deal much damage after piercing an enemy's body,
but when withdrawn it draws out the circulatory fluid within, causing prolonged torment.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon.sarariel.st: "Miss Vera, let's talk this out. I'll change your request right away - please put the blade down first." - Weapon Designer N
tooltip.icy_punishing.nut.desc: A common material containing important compounds.
tooltip.icy_punishing.nut.lore: A standard nut widely used in Golden Age industry. After the palladium-193 copolymer it contains was found to have extremely high biocompatibility, it became a key material for developing constructs.
tooltip.icy_punishing.nut_pack_small.des: Contains 10000 Nuts. Place in the central slot of the Upgrade screen to submit.
tooltip.icy_punishing.nut_pack_medium.de: Contains 20000 Nuts. Place in the central slot of the Upgrade screen to submit.
tooltip.icy_punishing.nut_pack_large.des: Contains 50000 Nuts. Place in the central slot of the Upgrade screen to submit.
tooltip.icy_punishing.nut_pack_xlarge.de: Contains 100000 Nuts. Place in the central slot of the Upgrade screen to submit.
tooltip.icy_punishing.nut_pack_xxlarge.d: Contains 200000 Nuts. Place in the central slot of the Upgrade screen to submit.
tooltip.icy_punishing.nut_pack.lore: Crates of nuts. Now that the compounds they contain are essential to construct production, these crates are worth far more than anyone could have imagined.
tooltip.icy_punishing.nut_pack.obtain: Obtained by: Chance drop from mobs based on armor value
tooltip.icy_punishing.skill_point.desc: A data program that deepens a member's understanding of skills, used to raise skill levels. Place in the central slot of the Upgrade screen to submit.
tooltip.icy_punishing.skill_point.lore: A chip loaded with various skill data that assists members in learning and strengthens their skills.
tooltip.icy_punishing.skill_point.obtain: Obtained by: 1 per 10 experience levels gained
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon_material.de: An enhancement kit that improves weapons; the high-entropy alloy content determines the degree of improvement.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon_material.lo: A rod-shaped weapon containing high-entropy alloy, commonly used to reinforce other weapons.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon_material.ob: Obtained by: Recycling iron swords / diamond swords / netherite swords
tooltip.icy_punishing.awareness_material: An enhancement kit that improves awareness chips; the capacity determines the degree of improvement.
The Science Council preserved the enhancement data of awareness chips to strengthen other awareness chips.
tooltip.icy_punishing.compute_fragment.d: Obtained by recycling awareness. Can be used as material to enhance awareness.
tooltip.icy_punishing.compute_fragment.l: After recycling redundant awareness shard data, a large amount of compute fragments can be efficiently organized and used to improve other awareness.
tooltip.icy_punishing.breakthrough_alloy: Can be fused with other materials to break the equipment level cap. Effective on low-star equipment.
An enhancement part containing trace high-entropy alloy, used to strengthen construct equipment.
Can be fused with other materials to break the equipment level cap. Effective on high-star equipment.
An enhancement part containing a large amount of high-entropy alloy, used to strengthen construct equipment.
tooltip.icy_punishing.weapon_breakthroug: A key material that can break the weapon level cap. Effective on low-star equipment.
A low-level computation core that strengthens weapon data, used to improve weapon strength.
A key material that can break the weapon level cap. Effective on high-star equipment.
An advanced computation core that strengthens weapon data, used to improve weapon strength.
tooltip.icy_punishing.awareness_circuit_: A key material that can break the awareness level cap. Effective on low-star equipment.
A primary part that expands the computation circuits of awareness chips, used to improve awareness strength.
A key material that can break the awareness level cap. Effective on high-star equipment.
An advanced part that expands the computation circuits of awareness chips, used to improve awareness strength.
tooltip.icy_punishing.exp_container_smal: An item that raises member level. Contains a small amount of experience.
tooltip.icy_punishing.exp_container_medi: An item that raises member level. Contains a moderate amount of experience.
tooltip.icy_punishing.exp_container_larg: An item that raises member level. Contains a large amount of experience.
tooltip.icy_punishing.exp_container_xlar: An item that raises member level. Contains an enormous amount of experience.
tooltip.icy_punishing.exp_container.lore: The Science Council converted constructs' combat data into mature combat experience and preserved it for other members to study.
tooltip.icy_punishing.exp_container.obta: Obtained by: Chance drop from mobs based on experience dropped
set.story.mernie:
[Mernie's Story]
As a human, Mernie was one of Universal Heavy Industries' architects, and many Golden Age buildings came from her hands.
Now Mernie aids the Art Association's archaeology team, working to find and preserve the ruins on the surface.
set.effect.pavty_2pc.desc: 2-piece: DMG +3% when attacking monsters within 2 blocks
set.effect.pavty_4pc.desc: 4-piece: DMG taken -3% when attacked by monsters within 2 blocks
set.story.pavty:
[Pavty's Story]
As a human, Pavty was a famous master of defense; any line she held would be miraculously defended no matter how unfavorable the conditions.
Now Pavty still protects constructs as best she can and launches fierce counterattacks against enemies who enter her attack range.
set.effect.pamelie_2pc.desc: 2-piece: DMG +3% when attacking monsters beyond 3 blocks
set.effect.pamelie_4pc.desc: 4-piece: DMG taken -3% when attacked by monsters beyond 3 blocks
set.story.pamelie:
[Pamelie's Story]
As a human, Pamelie was an outstanding scout who could always read the battlefield precisely and never missed any information in her surroundings.
Long-range combat is Pamelie's specialty, and she provides considerable help to constructs fighting at a distance.
set.effect.curie_cohet_2pc.desc: 2-piece: 20% chance to call in artillery when attacking a target, dealing 40% physical DMG (15-second cooldown)
set.story.curie_cohet:
[Curie-Cohet's Story]
Only donuts and donuts and donuts must not be let down - Curie.
set.effect.cunningham_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Physical and elemental DMG +5% when attacking enemies with super armor
set.effect.cunningham_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Taking consecutive hits within 5 seconds grants a damage-reduction shield; the next instance of DMG taken is reduced by 30% (5-second cooldown)
set.story.cunningham:
[Cunningham's Story]
As a human, Cunningham had excellent navigation skills and rich naval combat experience, providing much help to constructs in maritime operations.
Now Cunningham is overwhelmed dealing with matters in Murmansk.
set.effect.alice_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Healing a target grants it +4% physical and elemental DMG for 4 seconds
set.story.alice:
[Alice's Story]
As a human, Alice was a famous magician of the Golden Age whose card tricks and rabbit wand became signature features of her performances. A sweep of her rabbit wand leaves body and mind healed.
Now Alice keeps researching new magic acts and new ways to prank the Commandant.
set.effect.edison_4pc.desc: 4-piece: After a crit, own DMG +5% for 5 seconds
set.story.edison:
[Edison's Story]
As a human, Edison was a famous Golden Age scientist whose inventions greatly helped the era's development. Her appearance always brings new hope.
Besides developing high technology, Edison loves restoring relics of the old era; recently she has become obsessed with a device called a phonograph.
set.effect.archimedes_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Every 10 seconds, the next basic attack deals +10% DMG
set.story.archimedes:
[Archimedes's Story]
Archimedes opposes machines; rather than mechanical invention she prefers exploring mathematical models. Her calculations are incredibly precise on the battlefield and have helped constructs through many crises.
Now that she has become what she hates, she looks listless and unwilling to work.
set.story.nimitiz:
[Nimitz's Story]
As a human, Nimitz had excellent navigation skills and deep expertise in deep-sea operations, providing much help to constructs working underwater.
Now Nimitz handles matters at Murmansk Port together with Cunningham.
set.effect.aifu_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Each crit increases all DMG by 2% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 5 times
set.effect.aifu_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Every 60 seconds, the next crit grants the Supercomputing Space buff for 3 seconds
set.story.aifu:
[Aifu's Story]
As a human, Aifu was a sniper under Aidef. She remains alert at all times and holds her weapon in a sniping stance; when meeting someone for the first time she raises her gun and shoots instead of greeting them. Aifu's precise marksmanship provided enormous help to constructs on the battlefield.
Even with acquaintances, Aifu habitually wants to raise her gun and shoot, so she must struggle to control her grip. After much effort she realizes she has no body left and cannot shoot anyone at all.
set.effect.aike_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Extra DMG bonus +2%, all elemental DMG +4%
set.effect.aike_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Elemental DMG has a 15% chance to deal extra DMG of the matching element (8-second cooldown)
set.story.aike:
[Aike's Story]
As a human, Aike belonged to an underground organization from the mid-Immunity Era. Its members all bore obvious mechanical features; unlike constructs, they hated full-body modification and reinforced only certain parts. Aike was one of the organization's elite, though he seemed to harbor plans of his own. In combat, Aike's technique is always worthy of praise.
Now Aike has lost his body, yet he appears quite calm about it. Notably, Aike and Speaker Hassan seem to have known each other long ago.
set.effect.voltaire_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Attacks reduce the target's defense by 10% for 5 seconds (12-second cooldown)
set.effect.voltaire_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Each time DMG is taken, reduce the damage source's generic RES by 0.15 for 7 seconds, stacking up to 2 times
set.story.voltaire:
[Voltaire's Story]
As a human, Voltaire held an incomparable place in literature; her ideas inspired a generation of Golden Age writers. The prototype of the World Government first appeared in her works, laying the theoretical foundation for its formation. Voltaire can pinpoint an enemy's weak point and help constructs strike effectively.
Now Voltaire seems to be on bad terms with Shakespeare, and even the Commandant has not been told why.
set.effect.goroda_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Attacking a target reduces its all-elemental RES by 0.06 for 5 seconds (12-second cooldown)
set.effect.goroda_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Each time DMG is taken, reduce the all-elemental RES of monsters within 5 blocks by 0.06 for 7 seconds
set.story.goroda:
[Goroda's Story]
As a human, Goroda was an artillery gunner in the army and a firm no-sweets advocate. She excels at destroying all kinds of enemies and crushing their defenses to help constructs.
Goroda is confident in her aim; her creed is "if it won't blow open, blow it up again." In this she gets along well with Karenina.
set.effect.richelieu_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Healing +5%; the next heal grants the target +8% physical DMG for 4 seconds (5-second cooldown)
set.effect.richelieu_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Every 8 crits, add an extra crit DMG instance (on the 9th crit, additionally deal DMG equal to that crit) (5-second cooldown)
set.story.richelieu:
[Richelieu's Story]
As a human, Richelieu was one of the Church's cardinals in the early Golden Age. Foreseeing the decline of theology in that era, she proposed creating bionic robots to conduct religious activities. The plan was opposed and banned by the entire Church until everything unfolded exactly as Richelieu foresaw, at which point the Church urgently activated the "Church members" she had made. Notably, even within the Church, Richelieu's medical skill was second to none.
set.effect.samanda_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Healing +5%; the next heal grants the player +8% all elemental DMG for 4 seconds (5-second cooldown)
set.effect.samanda_4pc.desc: 4-piece: The next healing skill leaves an elemental aura; allies inside gain +8% all elemental DMG and +0.05 all elemental RES (10-second cooldown)
set.story.samanda:
[Samanda's Story]
As a human, Samanda had a strong affinity for creatures of all species from childhood, and being born a wealthy young lady, becoming the manager of the city's ecological research center was only natural. Now, besides aiding constructs with healing as an awareness chip, Samanda works at the Air Garden's ecological research center, offering all the help she can.
set.effect.mozart_2pc.desc: 2-piece: While the player has the Supercomputing Space buff, all DMG +15%
set.effect.mozart_4pc.desc: 4-piece: When the player gains the Supercomputing Space buff, deal 200% full-screen DMG (deal 200% void DMG based on the player's attack panel to entities affected by the buff)
set.story.mozart:
[Mozart's Story]
As a human, Mozart was devoted to exploring musical works from before the Golden Age. She integrated and reshaped these forgotten works, creating a new era's musical style; her compositions had a profound influence on the entire Golden Age music scene, and they are now all preserved in the square-wave radio station. Mozart's music is deeply soothing and inspiring in battle.
set.effect.boudica_4pc.desc: 4-piece: While the player has the Supercomputing Space buff, all ATK +5% and movement speed +10%
set.effect.boudica_6pc.desc: 6-piece: When dealing DMG, extra DMG bonus +3%, triggers once per 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times, lasting until the next time DMG is taken
set.story.boudica:
[Boudica's Story]
As a human, Boudica was a key figure during the Mechanical Restoration movement. She believed in mechanical awakening and held that machines should have equal rights with humans. To that end she led a large group of followers in armed resistance against those who oppressed machines. Boudica's awareness was later recovered by the World Government; her leadership and combat ability provide considerable help to frontline soldiers.
set.effect.einsteinna_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Minion DMG reduces the target's corresponding elemental RES by 15% for 8 seconds (10-second cooldown)
set.effect.einsteinna_4pc.desc: 4-piece: When DMG is taken, deploy an elemental aura granting 20% all elemental RES for 5 seconds; while the aura exists, elemental DMG +15% (8-second cooldown)
set.story.einsteinna:
[Einsteinna's Story]
As a human, Einsteinna was one of the most outstanding physicists of the Golden Age; her theory of relativity completely changed humanity's understanding of space and time. Her research not only advanced physics but also provided the theoretical basis for interstellar travel. On the battlefield, her theories help constructs better understand and wield elemental power.
Though Einsteinna has lost her body, her wisdom still shines, offering scientific guidance to the Commandant and constructs.
set.effect.kantlina_4pc.desc: 4-piece: 50% chance on attack to gain the Fury buff; basic attack extra DMG bonus +20% for 5 seconds (8-second cooldown)
set.story.kantlina:
[Kantlina's Story]
As a human, Kantlina was a great Golden Age philosopher whose "categorical imperative" became the cornerstone of the era's ethics. Her thought deeply influenced Golden Age law and social institutions. In battle, her philosophy grants constructs firm will and powerful combat strength.
Kantlina always believes in the power of reason and will not waver even in the hardest times.
set.effect.shakespeare_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Extra DMG bonus +10%. Attacks inflict Burn on the target (fire RES -15%) for 8 seconds (10-second cooldown). Attacking a burning target triggers an explosion dealing 600% fire DMG (6-second cooldown)
set.story.shakespeare:
[Shakespeare's Story]
As a human, Shakespeare was the greatest playwright and poet of the Golden Age; her works deeply depicted the complexity and beauty of human nature. Her plays are not only pinnacles of art but also carry profound life philosophy. On the battlefield, Shakespeare's words turn into flame, burning the enemy's will.
There seems to be some unknown entanglement between Shakespeare and Voltaire, which has become one of the Air Garden's great mysteries.
set.effect.heisenberg_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Extra DMG bonus +10%. Attacks inflict Electrified on the target (lightning RES -15%) for 8 seconds (10-second cooldown). Attacking an electrified target triggers a thunderstorm dealing 600% lightning DMG (6-second cooldown)
set.story.heisenberg:
[Heisenberg's Story]
As a human, Heisenberg was an outstanding Golden Age physicist; her uncertainty principle completely changed humanity's understanding of the microscopic world. Her research laid the foundation for quantum computing and energy weapons. On the battlefield, her theories help constructs command lightning and deliver fatal blows.
Heisenberg always wears a mysterious mask; no one knows her true face.
set.effect.darwin_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Each crit increases the extra DMG bonus by 3% for 4 seconds, stacking up to 5 times
set.effect.darwin_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Record crits, jump-attack crits and normal DMG; once all three are recorded, release a 12-block-diameter shockwave dealing 600% physical DMG
set.story.darwin:
[Darwin's Story]
As a human, Darwin was a great Golden Age biologist; her theory of evolution completely changed humanity's understanding of the origin of life. Her research not only advanced biology but also provided the theoretical basis for genetic engineering and biological modification. In battle, her theories help constructs adapt to any environment and evolve stronger combat ability.
Darwin deeply understands natural selection and believes only the strongest can survive in a cruel world.
set.effect.hanna_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Additionally multiply the player's crit stat by 1.1; every 30 seconds, the next crit grants the Supercomputing Space buff for 3 seconds
set.story.hanna:
[Hanna's Story]
As a human, Hanna was a famous Golden Age musician and composer whose works were full of longing for a beautiful life and the pursuit of freedom. Her music heals people's hearts and inspires their fighting spirit. On the battlefield, Hanna's music becomes power, providing strong combat support to constructs.
Hanna always believes music can change the world and will not give up hope even in the darkest moments.
set.effect.da_vinci_2pc.desc: 2-piece: With a minion within an 11x11x11 area around the player, player ATK +10% and defense stats +20%
set.effect.da_vinci_4pc.desc: 4-piece: When one minion attacks a target, other minions' aggro is forcibly locked onto it; with 3 or more minions nearby, all characters gain 20% ATK
set.story.da_vinci:
[Da Vinci's Story]
As a human, Da Vinci was one of the greatest geniuses of the Golden Age - not only an outstanding painter and sculptor but also a brilliant scientist, engineer and inventor. Her design blueprints laid a solid foundation for Golden Age technology. On the battlefield, Da Vinci's wisdom helps constructs better understand and wield mechanical power.
Da Vinci is always full of curiosity and eager to explore everything unknown.
set.effect.catherine_2pc.desc: 2-piece: When the player's minions attack or the player crits, reduce the target's physical RES by 20% for 8 seconds (10-second cooldown)
set.effect.catherine_4pc.desc: 4-piece: When DMG is taken, gain a 1000-point HP shield and +15% physical DMG for 5 seconds (8-second cooldown)
set.story.catherine:
[Catherine's Story]
As a human, Catherine was a famous Golden Age military strategist who excelled at commanding large-scale campaigns and directing battles from afar. Her tactical thought provided important guidance for construct combat. In battle, her strategies help constructs win at the lowest cost.
Catherine believes true victory lies not in destroying the enemy but in protecting what you treasure.
set.effect.feriet_ii_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Healing +10%; healed allies gain +10% physical DMG and +10% defense stats for 5 seconds (8-second cooldown)
set.effect.feriet_ii_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Each heal charges once (5 needed); when full, the next heal clears charges and summons an Allay; within 5 blocks it restores 2% of the player's max HP per second and grants +15% physical DMG for 5 seconds (12-second cooldown)
set.story.feriet_ii:
[Feriet II's Story]
As a human, Feriet II was a famous Golden Age medical expert devoted to researching new healing techniques who saved countless lives. Her medical philosophy emphasized both prevention and treatment, contributing enormously to the era's healthcare system. On the battlefield, her healing ability provides strong life support to constructs.
Feriet II always keeps the physician's oath, doing her utmost to save the wounded no matter how dangerous the situation.
set.effect.guiney_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Healing +10%; the healed target gains +10% all elemental DMG and RES for 5 seconds (8-second cooldown)
set.effect.guiney_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Same effect as Feriet II's 4-piece set
set.story.guiney:
[Guiney's Story]
As a human, Guiney was a famous Golden Age elementalist who studied the properties and interactions of the elements in depth, opening new territory for the application of elemental power. Her research helps constructs better control and utilize elemental forces. On the battlefield, her elemental knowledge provides powerful elemental support.
Guiney believes the elements are the cornerstone of the universe, and mastering their power means mastering the world's secrets.
set.effect.friedrich_2pc.desc: 2-piece: Each dodge grants +15% movement speed and +5% extra DMG bonus for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times; reapplication refreshes the duration. (Set effect not yet implemented)
set.effect.friedrich_4pc.desc: 4-piece: When a character triggers Supercomputing Space, all enemies' speed is reduced by 20%, and extra DMG reduction is lowered by 15% during Supercomputing Space / Supercomputing Prediction for 4 seconds. 8-second cooldown. (Set effect not yet implemented)
set.story.friedrich:
[Friedrich's Story]
As a human, Friedrich was a "famous" virtual idol during the Mechanical Restoration movement. She had no fixed stage but hid beneath the torrent of the network like a virus, appearing on someone's terminal from time to time to perform. Who created Friedrich can no longer be determined; some researchers believe she was likely modeled after Feriet II, a member of the early Golden Age Art Association, though the Culture Chairman has never responded to this. Her concealment and evasion techniques taught many constructs how to dodge in battle.
Friedrich herself does not know how she became an awareness chip, but that does not hinder her performances; since Friedrich joined, the Commandant is woken by her singing on time every day.
set.effect.patton_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Extra DMG bonus +10%. Attacks inflict Bleed on the target, reducing its physical RES by 7% for 8 seconds. 10-second cooldown per target. Attacking a bleeding target triggers an explosion dealing 600% physical DMG; 6-second cooldown per target.
set.story.patton:
[Patton's Story]
As a human, Patton was less a soldier than a bandit. She never wore a uniform, regarding such garments as useless paper; on the battlefield she only needed to know one thing - who to cut down. Patton's ferocious fighting style set an example for many constructs.
Until a certain conversation with the Commandant, Patton never understood why creatures around her would flee in fear whenever she appeared. Now Patton is working hard to control her fierce expression and her left hand's urge to draw her saber and start slashing.
set.effect.basilone_4pc.desc: 4-piece: Extra DMG bonus +10%. Attacks inflict Erosion on the target, reducing its dark RES by 15% for 8 seconds. 10-second cooldown per target. Attacking an eroded target triggers an explosion dealing 600% dark DMG; 6-second cooldown per target.
set.story.basilone:
[Basilone's Story]
As a human, Basilone was called the "King of Solo Combat" in the army; fighting many alone was her speciality. Despite repeated extraordinary achievements, Basilone remained an ordinary soldier until death, refusing honor and fame because she knew a comfortable life would never belong to her - only the battlefield was her home. Her combat experience helps constructs in battle.
Now Basilone returns to the battlefield in the form of an awareness chip, continuing to display her military talent. She does not mind lacking a body - in fact she is rather pleased, because she no longer has to worry about her hairline receding.

skill_desc.icy_punishing.honglian.red: Honglian - Opening Thrust: Lunge forward, pulling in the targets hit and dealing physical DMG. Deals %s/%s/%s physical DMG based on orbs consumed.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.honglian.yellow: Honglian - Flash Strike: Swiftly strike the target, launching it into the air and dealing physical DMG. Deals %s/%s/%s physical DMG based on orbs consumed.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.honglian.blue: Honglian - Wave Slash: The weapon bursts, dealing physical DMG and adding fire DMG to all attacks for a time. Deals %s/%s/%s physical DMG based on orbs consumed; adds %s/%s/%s fire DMG for 4/4/6 seconds.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.honglian.ult: Honglian Dance: 100 Signature Energy + press Signature. Performs rapid consecutive slashes and one heavy strike, dealing physical DMG. Each slash deals %s physical DMG and the heavy strike deals %s physical DMG.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.honglian.passiv: Core Passive - Honglian Twin Blades: After any 3-orb clear, if a red orb is cleared again within 4 seconds, Lucia: Lotus enters Burst state and uses Twin Blades instead of basic attacks, dealing a total of 1080% physical DMG. Leader Skill - Fearless Warrior: All attacking constructs gain 10% ATK. Class Skill - Attacker: Extra DMG bonus +20%.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.honglian.leap: Leap Node %s: After unlocking, enhances the corresponding leap effect; each level grants a 2% DMG bonus to all skills.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.red: Honglian - Wild Dance: Clear red orbs to unleash 5 consecutive attacks, dealing physical DMG; on a 3-orb clear the physical DMG converts to lightning DMG and you gain super armor during the attack. Deals %s/%s/%s physical DMG based on orbs consumed.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.yellow: Honglian - Thunder Field: Release a lightning field, dealing physical DMG to targets within and marking them; enemies inside take continuous lightning DMG. Marks stack up to 3 times; reapplication refreshes the duration. Deals %s/%s/%s physical DMG based on orbs consumed; deals %s/%s/%s lightning DMG per second; the field lasts 3/4/5 seconds.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.blue: Honglian - Arc Moon Slash: Swiftly attack the target, dealing lightning DMG and pulling it toward you, then deal physical DMG and mark it; marks stack up to 3 times; reapplication refreshes the duration. Deals %s/%s/%s lightning DMG based on orbs consumed; the pull deals %s/%s/%s physical DMG.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.ult: Honglian Sword: 50 Signature Energy + press Signature. While active, basic attacks and skills trigger additional Honglian Sword strikes dealing lightning DMG; recasting during the Signature state refreshes the duration. Strikes deal %s lightning DMG and last 15 seconds.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.passive: Core Passive - Honglian Thunder Dance: After clearing yellow/blue orbs, attacks against marked enemies have a chance to call down lightning, dealing lightning DMG. Based on the enemy's mark stacks, 25%/50%/75% chance to trigger lightning dealing %s lightning DMG. Leader Skill - Dawn Guide: All attacking constructs gain 10% ATK. Class Skill - Attacker: Extra DMG bonus +20%.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.leap1: Leap [Elegant Wild Dance]: Enhances [Honglian - Wild Dance] - extra DMG bonus on 3-orb clears +10%; after level 9, 3-orb clears pull nearby enemies; after level 18, during the Signature state a 3-orb clear allows holding basic attack to add Iai - Finishing Strike, dealing 360% lightning DMG.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.leap2: Leap [Thunder Realm]: Enhances [Honglian - Thunder Dance] - lightning strike extra DMG bonus +10%; after level 9, lightning trigger chance rises to 50%/75%/100%; after level 18, lightning is upgraded to Heaven's Thunder with an additional +10% DMG.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.leap3: Leap [Myriad Lotus Honglian Sword]: When casting [Signature - Honglian Sword], extra DMG bonus +10% for 10 seconds; reapplication refreshes the duration; after level 9, Honglian Sword energy regenerates automatically for 10 seconds after the Signature; after level 18, no Honglian Sword energy is consumed while off-field.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.red: Crimson Abyss - Shining Bloom: Clear red orbs to dash and strike targets in front, dealing physical DMG; on a 3-orb clear the final attack deals extra physical DMG and launches the target, and you gain super armor during the attack. Each attack deals %s/%s/%s physical DMG based on orbs consumed; the final 3-orb attack deals an extra %s physical DMG.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.yellow: Crimson Abyss - Wild Chaos: Clear yellow orbs to dash forward through enemies, dealing physical DMG to targets along the path. Deals %s/%s/%s physical DMG based on orbs consumed.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.blue: Crimson Abyss - Scattered Light: Clear blue orbs to enhance energy supply and enter an empowered state: movement speed increases and basic attacks and sword aura gain extra effects. Movement speed +%s/%s/%s based on orbs consumed; the empowered state lasts 5 seconds. During it, any attack adds 2 extra hits of %s/%s/%s physical DMG; clearing sword orbs during it adds %s/%s/%s physical DMG per sword aura.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.ult: Abyss Rift Art: 85 Signature Energy + press Signature. Unleash a slash at targets in front, dealing a total of %s physical DMG.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.passiv: Core Passive - Crimson Abyss Sword Will: After a 3-orb blue clear, the next any 3-orb clear makes you retreat into Sword Aura state; all current orbs become sword orbs and you gain 2 extra sword orbs; orbs gained from basic attacks in Sword Aura state also become sword orbs. 3-orb blue clear + any 3-orb clear: clearing sword orbs releases sword aura attacks dealing physical DMG, with super armor during the attack. Sword orbs deal %s physical DMG. Leader Skill - Abyss Resonance: All attacking constructs gain 10% ATK and 5% Crit. Class Skill - Attacker: Extra DMG bonus +20%.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.leap1: Leap [Crimson Abyss Heartflow]: 3-orb clears accumulate 1 Heart Blade (max 2); holding basic attack with a Heart Blade consumes 1 to release Reverse Flash Slash, dealing a total of 300% physical DMG; outside Sword Aura state, releasing it grants 1 random orb and rearranges orbs by 3-orb rules. After level 9, the blue-orb empowered state lasts 10 seconds; after level 18, Reverse Flash Slash base DMG +100%, and 3-orb yellow clears can also trigger [Crimson Abyss Unleashed].
skill_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.leap2: Leap [Creative No-Self]: In Sword Aura state, hold basic attack to consume 1 Heart Blade and release Reverse Flash Slash; releasing the hold consumes the remaining Heart Blades to release Sheathed Slash, dealing 600% physical DMG, invulnerable during it. After level 9, entering Sword Aura state restores 15 Signature Energy; after level 18, Sheathed Slash base DMG +100%, and you gain 35 Signature Energy on first entering combat. [Crimson Will] added: gain 2 extra orbs (blue) when leaving Sword Aura state.
skill_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.leap3: Leap [Abyss Rift - Thousand Slash Art]: In Sword Aura state, after pressing Signature you can hold basic attack to consume 2 Heart Blades and continuously consume sword orbs, releasing a sword aura burst when sheathing the Signature, dealing 350% physical DMG; each extra sword orb consumed increases base DMG by 50%; after level 9 this rises to 100%; after level 18, [Abyss Echo]'s physical DMG in the blue-orb state rises to 30%.
asc_desc.icy_punishing.honglian.1: Flash Strike - Aura Slash: When attacking launched targets, each attack adds 20% physical DMG.
asc_desc.icy_punishing.honglian.2: Endless Blade: In Twin Blades Burst state, extra DMG bonus +15%.
asc_desc.icy_punishing.honglian.3: Clear Mirror Core: Basic attack extra DMG bonus +15%. Final Liberation: On first entering combat, immediately gain three orbs.
asc_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.1: Superconduct: Within the thunder field, lightning DMG +20%.
asc_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.2: Thunder Burn: Lightning strike extra DMG bonus +20%.
asc_desc.icy_punishing.yingda.3: Dawn Liberation: After casting the Signature, extra DMG bonus +15% for 10 seconds; reapplication refreshes the duration. Final Liberation: On first entering combat, immediately gain three orbs.
asc_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.1: Crimson Abyss Unleashed: On a 3-orb red clear, physical DMG +10% for 4 seconds.
asc_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.2: Crimson Will: Extra DMG +5%; when Sword Aura state ends and returns to normal, gain 2 extra orbs.
asc_desc.icy_punishing.hongying.3: Abyss Echo: In the blue-orb empowered state, physical DMG +20%. Final Liberation: On first entering combat, immediately gain three orbs.
